# Subsets

## Main questions 

```{r}

tdata_main <- subset(tdata, select = c(1, 5:8))


tdata_main <- tdata_main %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(4:5), # Select columns to pivot
    names_to = "case", # Names for new columns
    values_to = "rating" # Separator in original column names
  )



tdata_main$comparison <- factor(tdata_main$comparison, levels = c("ic_cccf", "sl_cc"), 
                          labels = c("Pair 1", "Pair 2"))


tdata_main$case <- factor(tdata_main$case, levels = c("case_1", "case_2"), 
                     labels = c("case 1", "case 2"))


tdata_main$rating <- tdata_main$rating * 0.01 # convert to 0-1 scale

```

# Clusters 

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- 2. Define the Margin of Error ---
margin_of_error <- 3 # 3% margin (scale from 0 to 100)

# --- 3. Cluster Participants ---
tdata_clusters <- tdata %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate the difference for easier understanding
    rating_difference = case_2 - case_1,
    
    cluster = case_when(
      # Condition 1: No change (absolute difference is within the margin)
      # This condition must come FIRST to give precedence to the margin
      abs(rating_difference) <= margin_of_error ~ "no change",
      
      # Condition 2: Increase (cf_rating is sufficiently greater than ic_rating)
      # This means cf_rating - ic_rating > margin_of_error
      rating_difference > margin_of_error ~ "increase",
      
      # Condition 3: Decrease (ic_rating is sufficiently greater than cf_rating)
      # This means ic_rating - cf_rating > margin_of_error, or rating_difference < -margin_of_error
      rating_difference < -margin_of_error ~ "decrease",
      
      # Optional: A catch-all for any cases not covered (shouldn't happen with these conditions)
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
    )
  )

tdata_clusters$comparison <- factor(tdata_clusters$comparison, levels = c("ic_cccf", "sl_cc"), 
                          labels = c("Pair 1", "Pair 2"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(binom)

cluster_summary <- tdata_clusters %>%
  count(comparison, cluster, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    n_total = sum(n),
    p = n / n_total,
    percentage = 100 * p
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Wilson 95% CI for each bar
  bind_cols(
    binom.confint(
      x = .$n,
      n = .$n_total,
      methods = "wilson"
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        ci_low  = 100 * lower,
        ci_high = 100 * upper
      )
  )

clusters_plot <- cluster_summary

g4 <- ggplot(clusters_plot, aes(x = cluster, y = percentage, fill = comparison)) +
  guides(fill = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, labeller = labeller(comparison = comp_labels),
             nrow = 1, strip.position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 101), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Percentage",
       title = title_text, subtitle = subtitle_text, caption = caption_text) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#367A5D", "#D19032", "#296398", "#984335", "#8E7CC3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#367A5D", "#D19032", "#296398", "#984335", "#8E7CC3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = body_font, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = body_font, size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 40)
  )

g4

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. Define the Okabe-Ito Palette (Publication standard)
# This is a hand-picked professional palette
pub_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

# 2. Updated Mean Plot (G3)
g3 <- ggplot(tdata_sub, aes(x = case, y = rating, fill = comparison, color = comparison)) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, labeller = labeller(comparison = comp_labels), nrow = 1) +
  #facet_wrap( ~ causation_type, labeller = labeller(causation_type = comp_labels), nrow = 1, strip.position = "top")+
  # Background individual lines
  geom_line(aes(group = subj_code), 
            position = position_jitter(height = 0.02, width = 0.05), 
            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.2, color = NA, trim = TRUE) +
  
  # Summary: Color-matched lines and points
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.1) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white") +
  
  # Model Predictions (Black squares)
  geom_point(data = preds_plot, aes(x = case, y = prediction), 
             color = "black", fill = "black", size = 2.2, shape = 22) + 

  # Scales & Labels
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pub_palette) +
  labs(x = "Parameter Value", y = expression(bold(paste("P(e|c) Rating")))) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "body_font"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "grey92"), # Slightly darker for more 'structure'

    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

test if the normative cluster is the (absolute) majority cluster (i.e. > 50% of participants):

```{r}
summary_table <- cluster_summary


# --- Test 1: "increase" cluster > 50% in "ic_cccf" condition ---

# Extract relevant data for ic_cccf
n_increase_ic_cccf <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 1" & summary_table$cluster == "increase"]
n_decrease_ic_cccf <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 1" & summary_table$cluster == "decrease"]
n_no_change_ic_cccf <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 1" & summary_table$cluster == "no change"]

total_n_ic_cccf <- n_increase_ic_cccf + n_no_change_ic_cccf + n_decrease_ic_cccf

cat("--- Test 1: 'increase' cluster > 50% in 'ic_cccf' ---\n")
cat("Count for 'increase' in 'ic_cccf':", n_increase_ic_cccf, "\n")
cat("Total count for 'ic_cccf':", total_n_ic_cccf, "\n")

prop_test_ic_cccf <- prop.test(x = n_increase_ic_cccf,
                                n = total_n_ic_cccf,
                                p = 0.50,
                                alternative = "greater",
                                correct = TRUE) # correct = TRUE applies Yates' continuity correction
print(prop_test_ic_cccf)


# --- Test 2: "no change" cluster > 50% in "sl_ce" condition ---

# Extract relevant data for sl_ce
n_no_change_sl_cc <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 2" & summary_table$cluster == "no change"]
n_decrease_sl_cc <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 2" & summary_table$cluster == "decrease"]
n_increase_sl_cc <- summary_table$n[summary_table$comparison == "Pair 2" & summary_table$cluster == "increase"]

total_n_sl_cc <- n_no_change_sl_cc + n_decrease_sl_cc + n_increase_sl_cc

cat("\n--- Test 2: 'no change' cluster > 50% in 'sl_ce' ---\n")
cat("Count for 'no change' in 'sl_cc':", n_no_change_sl_cc, "\n")
cat("Total count for 'sl_ce':", total_n_sl_cc, "\n")

prop_test_sl_cc <- prop.test(x = n_no_change_sl_cc,
                             n = total_n_sl_cc,
                             p = 0.50,
                             alternative = "greater",
                             correct = TRUE)
print(prop_test_sl_cc)
```
